hypothesis: The 32px CIFAKE domain dominates the current training mixture. Reduce its contribution while keeping GenImage and approximately the same optimizer-update budget.
fixed: Same source splits, architecture, native crop geometry, JPEG balancing, optimizer, learning rate and seed 2026. Best epoch uses the existing GenImage/CIFAKE validation objective.
advance_gate: External development mean AUC improves >=0.02 on BOTH as-distributed and format-matched protocols; CIFAKE val AUC >=0.97, GenImage val AUC >=0.90. No deployment before calibration/FPR checks, matching explanations and new independent evaluation design.
test_policy: Do not score or tune against any reserved/test split. Keep v0.2.0 weights and final reports unchanged.
limitations: One seed, reused model-selection development data; similar rather than identical update counts and more validation looks. Not an isolated causal proof.
